newsitem.title: CHINA: China grain, edible oil prices drop in August.
newsitem.headline: China grain, edible oil prices drop in August.

text.p: China's grain and edible oil prices slipped in August compared with July, the Xinhua news agency quoted the Zhengzhou Grain and Edible oil Wholesale Information Centre as saying.
The wholesale prices of wheat and corn both dropped 2.03 percent, while the price of polished indica rice fell 0.34 percent and japonica rice was down by 1.70 percent.
The price of peanut oil fell by 3.81 percent, rapeseed oil dropped by 0.88 percent and soybean oil slipped 1.79 percent, it said.
